$description: TimelineChart (platform/charts/TimelineChart.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. Periods and events are the frame's marks and points (chart-*); these size the events and set the items' names. No new color: existing roles.

timeline-chart-event-radius.$description: Timeline chart: the radius of an event's point (an 8px point with the frame's ring, as the line charts' points).

timeline-chart-label-text.$description: Timeline chart: an item's name above its mark.

timeline-chart-label-font-family.$description: Timeline chart: item names are UI text: the label font.

timeline-chart-label-font-size.$description: Timeline chart: an item's name's size.

timeline-chart-label-offset.$description: Timeline chart: the distance between an item's name and its mark.

timeline-chart-label-halo-color.$description: Timeline chart: the halo under a name, in the surface color, so it reads over grid lines.
